row: Chatting with a contact asks for no phone number and nothing to buy, by Status's own pages. The account is a key she alone holds.
sticker.back: What it is: Status, a free, open-source app joining an encrypted messenger and a crypto wallet. What you hold: a pair of keys, a password, twelve written words. What you give up: nobody resets a password; contacts are added one by one. The wrong idea: that chatting needs crypto. Named as an example, not a recommendation. Checked 2026-11-23.
